title: Context IR
description: Versioned Context Intermediate Representation: verbatim units with provenance, typed relationships, selection record, sufficiency judgement and restoration log. Minimal example: one unit with provenance origin path:lines, selection kept [blk id], sufficiency sufficient true. Transcribed from docs/msi/05-msi-spec-v0.md section 2. Relationship enum matches graph edge types: SUPPORTS QUALIFIES CONTRADICTS SUPERSEDES DEPENDS_ON DUPLICATES DERIVED_FROM.

schema_version.description: Schema identifier and version. Must equal context-ir/0.1.

ir_version.description: IR format version, independent from schema envelope version.

task_id.description: Links this IR to its Task Contract.

units.description: Verbatim context units. Content is never summarized, only selected or trimmed.

source.description: Source pointer: path:lines, tool:call_id or url.

provenance.description: Origin lineage of the unit. Survives all selection stages.

origin.description: Where the bytes came from (file path, tool name, url).

transform.description: Deterministic transform applied: none, clean or dedupe. Never summarization.

relevance.description: Lexical or scored relevance in [0,1]. Relevance is not necessity.

necessity.description: Causal necessity label. Default UNKNOWN until ablation assigns a stronger label.

semantic_risk.description: Estimated risk of dropping this unit (0 low, 1 high).

protected.description: True means the unit must never be silently dropped; a reason is required.

dependencies.description: Ids of units this unit depends on.

relationships.description: Typed edges from this unit to other units.
Graph-level edges (redundant with per-unit edges; either location is valid).

selection.description: What was kept, trimmed or dropped, under which policy and why.

kept.description: Ids of units in the working set.

trimmed.description: Ids of units shortened but retained.

dropped.description: Ids of units excluded from the working set. Every dropped unit must be explainable.

policy.description: Name and version of the selection policy (e.g. lexical-1.0).

rationale.description: Map from unit id to human-readable reason string.

sufficiency.description: Whether the kept set suffices for the task.

sufficient.description: True when the kept set covers the task; false triggers restoration.

missing_evidence.description: Descriptions of evidence still missing when sufficient is false.

restoration.description: Bounded restore log. Restores come from the original units only.

restored.description: Ids of units restored after a sufficiency or verification failure.

budget.description: Maximum number of restorations allowed for this IR.

reason.description: Why restoration happened (or empty string when nothing was restored).
